_comment: Candidate catalog of trending dropship products evaluated for the Las Vegas market. demand_score (0-100) and vegas_fit (0.8-1.6) are analyst-curated from cited sources. All cost fields marked in _assumptions are planning estimates that must be re-verified with live supplier quotes before ordering.
_assumptions: cogs_china / cogs_bulk / cogs_us_dropship / dropship shipping costs are planning estimates from typical AliExpress, CJ, Zendrop and Alibaba listings as of mid-2026; verify with live quotes.
cac (customer acquisition cost per order via paid social) assumes a maturing Meta/TikTok ad account; first-30-day CAC is typically 1.5-2x higher.
dominant_offer_delivery_days = what a Las Vegas buyer typically experiences today when ordering the trending version of the product (p25-p75 days).

products.name: Bladeless neck fan (portable neck AC)
products.demand_rationale: Portable/personal cooling leads mid-2026 trending lists; extreme-heat preparedness has shifted cooling from seasonal accessory to necessity (CJ Dropshipping June 2026 winners, Trendtrack Summer 2026).
products.vegas_rationale: 100-110F June-Aug; 38.5M annual visitors walking an outdoor Strip; pool season Mar-Oct; outdoor workers and event staff.
products.delivery_rationale: Trending TikTok versions are sold through Shopify stores fulfilling via AliExpress/CJ China warehouses (8-22 days to US). Amazon carries commodity versions but the viral SKUs lag.
products.risk_notes: Battery/lithium shipping restrictions; quality variance drives returns; seasonal demand cliff in winter.

products.name: Handheld turbo misting fan
products.demand_rationale: Sister SKU to portable fans on 2026 summer winning-product lists; strong impulse-buy price point.
products.vegas_rationale: Pool parties, dayclubs, festivals, sports events; tourists buy on-arrival when they feel the heat — same-day availability is the whole sale.
products.delivery_rationale: Dominant offers ship from China warehouses (AliExpress standard 8-20 days).
products.risk_notes: Commodity exposure; differentiate on bundle (fan + cooling towel) and same-day delivery.

products.name: PVA instant cooling towel (3-pack)
products.demand_rationale: Steady heat-relief staple rather than viral spike; consistent summer seller with very high gross margin.
products.vegas_rationale: Golfers (year-round golf market), Red Rock hikers, Strip pedestrians, outdoor hospitality staff.
products.delivery_rationale: Mixed: some Amazon depth exists, but branded/bundled versions still dominated by China dropship offers.
products.risk_notes: Low ticket — needs bundles or multipacks to clear CAC; heavy commodity competition.

products.name: Oversized pool float / tanning lounger
products.demand_rationale: Evergreen summer category with recurring viral designs each season; big-ticket impulse for pool owners and party hosts.
products.vegas_rationale: Pool capital of the US: ~2.4M metro residents with high private-pool density, Airbnb party houses, dayclub culture, Mar-Oct season.
products.delivery_rationale: Bulky + low value density means most trend designs ship slow economy lines from China; buyers routinely miss the party they bought it for.
products.risk_notes: Bulky storage cost; strict seasonality; deflate/returns handling.

products.name: 2L festival hydration backpack
products.demand_rationale: Festival gear demand is structural and growing; hydration packs are mandatory kit for desert festivals and hikes.
products.vegas_rationale: EDC Las Vegas 2026 drew 510,000+ over three nights; year-round pool festivals, Red Rock/Valley of Fire hiking; last-minute festival buyers cannot wait 2 weeks.
products.delivery_rationale: Rave-styled packs (LED, holographic) are China-dropship dominated; Amazon stocks plain outdoor versions, not festival styles.
products.seasonality: Year-round with hard spikes around EDC (May) and festival calendar
products.risk_notes: Style-driven inventory risk; bladder quality complaints if unvetted.

products.name: LED gloves & fiber-optic whip set
products.demand_rationale: Nightlife/festival accessories sell continuously; LED/glow category refreshes with each festival cycle.
products.vegas_rationale: EDC 510K+, year-round nightclub economy, bachelor/ette groups seeking glow accessories same-day.
products.delivery_rationale: Specialty rave retailers ship from China or slow domestic; same-day availability in Vegas is effectively zero outside marked-up party stores.
products.seasonality: Year-round, spike around EDC (May) and NYE

products.name: Premium clay poker chip set (500pc, case)
products.demand_rationale: Home-game poker is a durable hobby market; premium sets are gift/identity purchases with high AOV.
products.vegas_rationale: Tourists want a Vegas souvenir with utility; locals host games; corporate/convention gifting (6M convention attendees).
products.delivery_rationale: Heavy item = expensive fast shipping, so most non-Amazon offers use slow freight lines; Amazon selection is mid-tier, premium/custom sets lag.
products.seasonality: Year-round; Dec gifting and NFR spike
products.risk_notes: Heavy = high fulfillment cost every channel; damage in transit; capital-intensive inventory.

products.name: Bachelorette party kit (sashes, veils, props)
products.demand_rationale: Party kits are perennial dropship winners; purchase is deadline-driven (event date) which punishes slow shipping and rewards local availability.
products.vegas_rationale: Wedding capital: Clark County issued 76,779 marriage licenses in 2024 (~210/day); bachelorette capital of the US; ~4% of visitors come specifically for weddings ($3.3B output).
products.delivery_rationale: Etsy/Shopify sellers dropship from China; planners who forget items have no same-day fallback beyond thin party-store stock.
products.risk_notes: Taste-driven; needs fresh designs; low repurchase (one-time event buyers).

products.name: Gel pet cooling mat
products.demand_rationale: Pet accessories generated the strongest 2026 demand signal in tracked datasets (+3.4M impressions/7d for personalized pet); cooling subcategory rides the heat trend.
products.vegas_rationale: 2.4M metro residents, high dog ownership, 110F pavement makes pet heat protection a safety purchase, Apr-Oct.
products.delivery_rationale: Trend versions (XL, orthopedic hybrid) dominated by China dropship; Amazon covers basic mats.
products.risk_notes: Gel leak complaints on cheap versions — QC critical; bulky-ish storage.

products.name: Rain cloud aroma diffuser / humidifier
products.demand_rationale: Named 2026 viral product (mesmerizing water-drip design, 7 night-light modes); strong TikTok engagement.
products.vegas_rationale: Desert dryness helps humidifier demand slightly, but this is a national trend play, not a Vegas-specific gap.
products.delivery_rationale: Classic viral-gadget pattern: China dropship only until Amazon clones catch up.
products.risk_notes: Trend decay risk; electronics DOA rate; Amazon clone compression within 1-2 quarters.

products.name: Mini WiFi projector
products.demand_rationale: Consistent top-10 tech dropship item into 2026; backyard-movie use case fits Sunbelt.
products.vegas_rationale: Backyard/patio culture helps; but Amazon services this category deeply — weak local gap.
products.delivery_rationale: Amazon has deep fast-shipping selection; the delivery gap mostly does not exist for commodity projectors.
products.risk_notes: High return rate (8%+), 8% electronics referral helps but support burden is real; brand competition.

products.name: Magnetic phone mount / grip
products.demand_rationale: Named 2026 trending accessory; huge volume but heavily commoditized.
products.vegas_rationale: Rideshare-heavy city helps volume slightly; no structural local gap.
products.delivery_rationale: Amazon is saturated with next-day options — included as a control: high demand, near-zero under-service.
products.risk_notes: Race-to-the-bottom pricing; ad costs exceed margin for undifferentiated sellers.

products.name: Foldable duffel / travel bag
products.demand_rationale: 2026 trending pick solving a universal traveler problem (overflow storage for the trip home).
products.vegas_rationale: 38.5M visitors/yr who shop more than they packed; hotel-deliverable same-day is a unique wedge.
products.delivery_rationale: Trend versions China-dropshipped; Amazon has basics but same-day-to-hotel is unserved.

products.name: Plush pillow phone holder
products.demand_rationale: 2026 TikTok/Instagram trending item for binge-watching and video calls.
products.vegas_rationale: No Vegas-specific driver — pure national trend; included as a contrast case.

products.name: Golf towel + brush + divot tool kit
products.demand_rationale: Golf accessories are a steady dropship niche with gift-driven spikes; not viral but durable.
products.vegas_rationale: Year-round golf destination (50+ courses), corporate/convention gifting market (6M convention attendees), snowbird season.
products.delivery_rationale: Custom/premium kits ship from China; Amazon covers basics.
products.risk_notes: Niche ceiling; personalization is the differentiator (POD angle).
